# notes

A small, pre-existing notes service used as the brownfield target. FastAPI + stdlib sqlite3.

- `POST /notes` create a note with tags
- `GET /notes?tag=` list notes, optionally filtered by tag
- `GET /notes/{id}` fetch one
- `DELETE /notes/{id}` delete one

## Performance

Listing notes runs a constant number of queries regardless of how many notes are returned: tags are loaded in one batched query and the tag filter runs in SQL. `note_tags` is indexed on `note_id` and `tag`. `tests/test_performance.py` fails if the per-note query pattern (N+1) comes back.

Run tests with `pytest` from this directory.
